progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on E in Mansuri. Forud (0:41.8) introduces Bk, Db, D, Fs, Ab, centred on A. The line peaks at Ab4 (427.2 Hz) at 0:54.4. It closes on Bk3, not the tonic (E4 → Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → A3 → Bk3).
